blocks.title: What we collect
paragraphs: When you write to us we keep your name, your work email and your message so we can reply. Write to [hello@quayside.example](mailto:hello@quayside.example) with any question.

blocks.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep an enquiry for as long as we need it to answer you and to run the account that follows.

bullets: Ask for a copy of what we hold
Ask us to correct or delete it
